layout.arrangement: A large light-gray slide background with a thick red rectangular border inset from the slide edges. Inside the red border is a white square scatter plot occupying most of the area; axes run from -10 to 40 on both x and y with gridlines. Seven colored point clusters are distributed across the plot. A small black curved arrow sits between the red and cyan clusters near the top center. A small yellow circle with the number 42 is in the top-right corner outside the red border but inside the gray slide area. A black strip runs along the bottom edge of the slide.

recreation_brief:
1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with a light gray background (approx #D3D3D3).
2. Add a thick red rectangle border inset from the slide edges to form the plot frame.
3. Inside the border, insert a white square plotting area spanning most of the interior.
4. Add x-axis and y-axis with tick labels 0, 10, 20, 30, 40 on the x-axis and -10, 0, 10, 20, 30, 40 on the y-axis; include light gray gridlines.
5. Draw seven point clusters using small filled circles: dark blue upper-left elongated; yellow mid-left small; green lower-left small; magenta large lower-center; red upper-center; black right-side mid-lower; cyan right-side upper. Use approximate colors: blue #0000FF, yellow #FFFF00, green #00FF00, magenta #FF00FF, red #FF0000, black #000000, cyan #00FFFF.
6. Add a small black curved arrow between the red cluster and the cyan cluster near the top center.
7. Place a yellow circle with the black number 42 in the top-right corner, outside the red border but on the slide.
8. Add a solid black horizontal strip along the bottom edge of the slide.
